name: Veloria
description: Veloria is a radiant and refreshing fragrance that blooms with delicate floral notes and the soft elegance of fresh roses. Bright citrus accents add a sparkling freshness, while aquatic nuances evoke the feeling of a gentle ocean breeze. Subtle woody undertones and a touch of fresh spice bring balance and sophistication, creating a scent that is graceful, uplifting, and effortlessly elegant.
